subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
6. 
Which of the following best describes the analytical procedure applied by the auditor to 
evaluate the reasonableness of hostel rent income? 
(a)  
Trend analysis comparing hostel income with the previous year. 
(b)  
Reasonableness test using non-financial data to estimate expected income. 
(c)  
Verification of hostel fee receipts with the Cash Book. 
(d)  
Test of controls over hostel fee collection.
